_: Editor's log of the phone footage (data/videos), from contact sheets of every clip, with who is in it as Tom confirmed it (rider check, 18.10). `use`: usable [in, out] seconds. `sightings`: a rider at clip second `at` (passing the camera, or followed by it). sync.py takes the race clock from the riders' FIT rides (tracks.py) and the exact second from here. Helmets: El Halcon orange, Los Locos white, El Szczupak blue, Krzys grey, El Lobo red, Karol grey, Rafi white.

IMG_5363.MOV.what: Morning roll-out on the flat (10:21), about 17 km away, before the ride

IMG_5364.MOV.what: Roll-out on farm roads: the group strung out ahead, the filmer's shadow on the fence

IMG_7771.MOV.what: Caimari village, before the start: all seven roll through between yellow houses and green shutters

IMG_7772.MOV.what: Leaving Caimari: the crossed-out town sign, the climb begins

IMG_7774.MOV.what: The gorge: the whole bunch on a hairpin under rock walls, El Halcon in front with Los Locos

IMG_7778.MOV.what: Roadside under olive trees: the front three (Los Locos, El Halcon, El Szczupak) come up the road; El Szczupak passes close

IMG_7782.MOV.what: The stone-wall balcony: the front three, Los Locos in front of El Halcon, mountains and big clouds behind

IMG_7786.MOV.what: On El Halcon's wheel, close, after his attack

IMG_7787.MOV.what: Roadside: El Halcon clear in front, passes in profile; Los Locos 12 m back

IMG_7789.MOV.what: Roadside under pines: El Halcon alone, Los Locos chasing, a car behind the riders

IMG_7792.MOV.what: The last hairpin below the col: El Szczupak rises out of it, passes, rides to the top

IMG_7793.MOV.what: The last hairpin: a passer-by waves, then Krzys climbs out of the bend and passes with a grin

IMG_7794.MOV.what: The last hairpin: El Lobo crosses it, passes, a whip pan, the COLL DE SA BATALLA 576 m sign. He lost a bet to Krzys (penalty: the horn, 'Klakson')

IMG_7795.MOV.what: The last two: Karol, then Rafi two seconds behind, to the summit sign

VMGY3907.MP4.what: El Lobo's selfie at the summit café after the climb
